summary: Independent verification of the new off-site backup admin surface. Backend: /api/admin/backup-status returns 200 for owner with expected shape (local_backup, offsite_copy, offsite_restore_drill each with status/ok/timestamp; plus local_backup_count and backup_dir); returns 401 unauth; returns 403 for a sales user. Regression sanity endpoints (/api/health, /api/users, /api/materials) all 200 for owner. Frontend: owner sees 'Backups' nav item under Administration, navigates to /admin/backups, page renders three StatusRows (OK/OK/PASS with timestamps), 'Local backups retained: 5', Refresh button, no restore/backup mutation buttons. Sales user does NOT see the Administration section or Backups nav item; direct navigation to /admin/backups is blocked with an 'Access restricted' notice. 6/6 pytest cases passed.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_ops.py is clean and read-only; parse of status file uses whitespace split which is robust. Consider tolerating trailing newlines/comments if the writer format changes (minor).

BackupStatus.jsx has no error state UI: if /admin/backup-status fails (e.g., 403 for a stray sensitive role misconfig), the card silently shows '—' rows. Adding a small error toast/inline banner would improve observability (nit).
test_credentials: Owner pjacobsen@asgardsolution.io / RoofSpan#Owner2026 (worked). Sales user created via API and deleted after run.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral sales user created via POST /api/users (deleted in fixture teardown; one leftover 'TEST Sales UI' user created via browser eval remains — main agent may wish to purge).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_backup_status.py provides RBAC + shape assertions for /api/admin/backup-status and light regression on /health, /users, /materials. Off-site copy and restore drill showed OK/PASS status timestamps in the running env.
